projectDescription: A ready-to-fork Jekyll-based GitHub Pages template for building personal academic portfolio websites featuring publications, talks, teaching, CV, and blog sections.
keyFeatures: Ready-to-fork Jekyll template hosted on GitHub Pages for free
Dedicated collections for publications, talks, teaching, and portfolio items
Dual CV formats: Markdown-based and JSON-based (JSONResume schema)
Author profile sidebar with links to Google Scholar, ORCID, GitHub, and more
Multiple built-in visual themes (default, air, sunrise, mint, dirt, contrast) with light/dark variants
Markdown generator scripts/notebooks to bulk-create content from CSV/TSV files
Interactive talk map generated via Python/Jupyter using Leaflet.js
Comment system integrations (Disqus, Discourse, Facebook, Staticman)
Analytics integrations (Google Analytics 4, Universal Analytics, custom)
Docker and VS Code DevContainer support for local development
publicApiSurface: _config.yml — site-wide configuration (title, url, author, theme, analytics, comments, collections)
_publications/*.md — publication entries (YAML front matter: title, collection, category, permalink, date, venue, paperurl, bibtexurl, citation)
_talks/*.md — talk entries (YAML front matter: title, collection, type, permalink, venue, date, location)
_teaching/*.md — teaching entries (YAML front matter: title, collection, type, permalink, venue, date, location)
_portfolio/*.md — portfolio entries (YAML front matter: title, excerpt, header, url_btn)
_posts/*.md — blog post entries (standard Jekyll post front matter)
_pages/*.md — standalone pages (YAML front matter: permalink, title, layout, author_profile)
scripts/cv_markdown_to_json.py — converts Markdown CV to cv.json
talkmap.py / talkmap.ipynb — generates interactive Leaflet talk map
site_theme in _config.yml — selects visual theme (default, air, sunrise, mint, dirt, contrast)
publication_category in _config.yml — defines publication category headings (books, manuscripts, conferences)
